writer.markdown:
# Question: How large was the state bus replacement grant and what does it cover?

## Answer
The state awarded the transit agency a 4.2 billion dollar grant in 2025 to replace 30 diesel buses [S1].

## Evidence
- Annual ridership on the affected routes was 1,600,000 trips [S1].
- The agency capital plan lists fleet replacement costs of 96 thousand dollars over ten years [S2].
- The plan expects the grant to cover the first 30 buses only [S2].

## Counter-evidence and limits
- The grant covers only part of the ten-year fleet replacement plan (judgment).

## Next actions
- Ask the agency how the remaining buses will be funded (judgment)

## Sources
- [S1] State transit grant announcement
- [S2] Transit agency capital plan
